This page is maintained by hand. For code and ongoing analyses, see our [software](software.qmd) and [projects](projects.qmd) pages.

## Collaborations

* [CMMID](https://cmmid.lshtm.ac.uk/): the Centre for the Mathematical Modelling of Infectious Diseases at LSHTM, which we are part of.
* [epinowcast](https://www.epinowcast.org/): a community developing tools and methods for real-time nowcasting and forecasting of infectious diseases.
* [Modelling hubs](https://hubverse.io/): the hubverse provides open tools for building collaborative modelling hubs, which we have been closely involved with.

## Training

* [Nowcasting and Forecasting of Infectious Disease Dynamics (NFIDD)](https://nfidd.github.io/nfidd/): an open course on nowcasting and forecasting infectious disease dynamics.

## Group manual

Our [group manual](group-manual.qmd) describes how we work together.
